title: Open Trestle Model Capabilities v1
description: Canonical interchange shape for declared model capabilities. Runtime validation must also require max_output_tokens to be less than or equal to max_context_tokens. Schema validation does not enforce that cross-field rule or prove provider claims.

supported_features.description: Declared optional model features. Array order has no meaning.

max_output_tokens.description: Declared maximum output capacity. Trusted runtime validation must reject values above max_context_tokens; schema validation does not enforce that relation or prove the declaration.
